# tmnciesc.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

A vulnerable kernel driver that can be used to disable Code Integrity
- **UUID**: 2b1e1095-5119-4419-9790-4206b23be0b5
- **Created**: 2026-10-25
- **Author**: Andrea Monzani
- **Acknowledgement**: Andrea Monzani, Davide Netti, Antonio Parata | [](https://twitter.com/)

{{< button "https://github.com/magicsword-io/LOLDrivers/raw/main/drivers/0e21f1bd9c7eeb87665213810735b56c.bin" "Download" >}}
{{< tip "warning" >}}
This download link contains the vulnerable driver!

{{< /tip >}}

{{< blockbanner "tmnciesc.sys" >}}
### Commands

```
sc.exe create tmnciesc binPath=C:\windows\temp\tmnciesc.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start tmnciesc
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | kernel | Windows 10 |
